note: vespera-bridge: the native loader no longer decides who the current user is from a probe file inside the directory it is still verifying (procfs, a java.io.tmpdir probe or the user.name lookup come first; the in-directory probe is a guarded, uncached last resort), closing a local-user library swap race. The servlet proxy reports a request whose error response could not be written, and tags a failing DispatchModeResolver with the selected app. A closed child context no longer disables the DIRECT buffer pool. A spec-conforming case-insensitive getHeaders no longer forwards duplicated header values. A sub-millisecond native dispatch-timeout rounds up to 1 ms and a negative one fails startup. The WebFlux 413 with an unlimited cap names the built-in bound. Doc fixes in the README and the Gradle plugin targets KDoc.
